about: Cross-fades and tints (r94): each scene starts one 4 s in and lasts 4 s, so t6 is mid-fade and t12 after it; t06 starts a second at 5 s (r98); t07 and t08 fade each layer slot in its own window, back slots first (depth stagger, r249); t09 and t10 dissolve (r250); t11 and t12 go through a colour (r251); t13 and t14 creep into a mist and out of it (r252). Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots and engines/godot/tests/shots.gd.

scenes.name: into-more-layers
scenes.about: Hiver (7 layers, repeat X, mirrored) into Calm (9 layers, another atlas): the 2 back layers of Calm have no counterpart

scenes.name: into-fewer-layers
scenes.about: Calm (9 layers) into OneNight (6 layers, useOriginalSize, dark gradients): the 3 back layers of Calm fade out alone

scenes.name: into-itself-tinted
scenes.about: repeat XY: a cross-fade into the page on screen (its layers cloned), while tinting orange

scenes.name: no-repeat-into-gradients
scenes.about: no repeat, white gradients into c06's coloured ones: the colours fade, the sizes stay c05's

scenes.name: tint-translucent
scenes.about: repeat Y, mirrored: a tint only, to a half-transparent night blue

scenes.name: interrupted
scenes.about: Hiver (7 layers) starts fading into Calm (9) at 4 s, then into OneNight (6) at 5 s: Calm is dropped, Hiver pops back to full opacity and fades again; the gradients restart from where they were

scenes.name: depth-stagger-into-more-layers
scenes.about: t01 with a depth stagger of 1: at t6, half way, Calm's back slot is all in and Hiver's front one not yet started; Calm's 2 extra back slots lead

scenes.name: depth-stagger-into-fewer-layers
scenes.about: t02 with the largest stagger, 2: at t6 the back slots are all OneNight (Calm's 3 extra ones gone), the front ones still Calm

scenes.name: dissolve-into-more-layers
scenes.about: t01 as a dissolve (r250), the transfert lab's D: 5 patches across, edges 0.08 soft, stagger 0.5; at t6 each slot's Calm layer has eaten part of Hiver's, the back slots further

scenes.name: dissolve-hard-into-fewer-layers
scenes.about: t02 as a dissolve with hard edges (0.01), 3 patches, every slot at once: at t6 half of each slot is OneNight, the other half Calm, cut sharp

scenes.name: through-white-into-more-layers
scenes.about: t01 through white (r251), every slot at once, started at 3.5 s: the whole screen white at 5.5 s, and at t6 Calm and its gradients coming out of the white, 75% of the way still white

scenes.name: through-orange-from-a-fogged-page-staggered
scenes.about: f01 (a page fog, a WAVE and a FOG layer) through a warm orange into Calm, stagger 1 (r251): at t6 the back slots are Calm coming out of the orange, the front ones f01 going into it, mixed toward the orange after their fog

scenes.name: fog-creep-in-far-first
scenes.about: t01 as a fog creep into the page fog's white mist (r252), stagger 1, started at 4.6 s: at t6, 35% in, Hiver's far slots all mist, its near ones going into it, the gradients white; Calm not drawn yet

scenes.name: fog-creep-out-near-first-from-a-fogged-page
scenes.about: f01 (a page fog, a WAVE and a FOG layer) as a fog creep into a grey-blue mist, into Calm, stagger 1 (r252), started at 3.4 s: at t6, 65% in, Calm coming out of the mist, its near slots clear first, its far ones still under it
